sideConvention: Physical character right=screen-left; left=screen-right in S.
limitations: The complete right brow band retains native study RGB without reference/study splices; the left band retains native reference RGB through its tapered tail.

Manually traced fractional contour vertices produce deterministic 4x4 geometric coverage of each native detailed pixel; only alpha is multiplied by coverage. No image resampling, blur, transforms or mirroring.
Soft coverage tapers the character-left tail into actual foreground-hair occlusion and smooths the character-right contour.
All generated edits outside brow bands, including background, are discarded; approved revision-5 anatomy/hair/features/folds remain unchanged.
Concealed geometry, other expressions/facings, materials and production acceptance remain unfinished.
